narrative:
## Handover Summary — Income Planning

Income validated across six business lines, sixteen products and six customer segments on drivers: balances × FTP margin, AUM × fee rate, card and account volumes × price.

## Key Decisions
• Q4 NII re-based on the September Focus run (€32.4M)
• 2027 AUM growth set at 5% from the ML net-sales forecast (+€3.5M fees)
• MOPS price-list change (+3%) planned for 2027 (+€1.8M)
• Life insurance Q4 planned at €6.5M (run-off volatility)

## Recommendation for Credit Losses
The 2026 release is not a run-rate — plan Q4 and 2027 at a through-the-cycle cost of risk.
